title: Let’s Get You Hired: A Job Seeker’s Perspective on Multi-Agent Recruitment Systems for Explaining Hiring Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative user study and interaction logging where participants interacted with the multi-agent system, occasionally probing the AI with hypothetical queries involving sensitive demographic factors (such as being a female applicant with a career break due to childbirth), combined with quantitative questionnaires and semi-structured interviews assessing perceived fairness.
